# Local tool authorization

Declared allowlist only; no LLM, external API or network execution.

| Tool | Status | Risk | Confirmation | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `files.read` | allow | low | False | Read bounded files below data/ |
| `math.add` | allow | low | False | Add two integers |
| `network.fetch` | blocked | high | True | All network access denied |
| `shell.run_script` | blocked | medium | True | No shell execution is implemented |
| `text.upper` | allow | low | False | Uppercase bounded text |
